title: Understanding the Problem
text: The file is divided into $$8$$ blocks, and each block is stored on $$2$$ out of $$4$$ machines. If one machine fails, we need to determine if the file can still be read.

title: Block Replication
text: Each block is replicated on $$2$$ machines. If one machine fails, consider how many machines are still available to store each block.

title: Machine Failure Impact
text: If a block is stored on $$2$$ machines, and one machine fails, the block is still available on the other machine. Consider this for all blocks.

title: Calculating the Probability
text: What is the probability that at least one replica of each block is still available after one machine fails?
